state_object.description: struct that holds reusable matching state

state_initializer.description: one-time initializer for the reusable state object

per_match_state_resetter.description: routine that resets per-match fields on a reused state object

transient_guard_counter.description: field that tracks recursion/stack-depth and is decremented before recursive calls and incremented on normal exit

guard_check.description: condition that checks the transient guard counter before recursion

guard_restore.description: operation that restores the transient guard counter on normal exit

non_local_error_abort.description: function/macro that aborts via non-local error, skipping cleanup

reusing_iterator.description: iterator/closure that reuses the state object across multiple matches
